top_signals.title: Nvidia Sinks as Analyst Downgrades Start to Come In: Street Wrap
top_signals.summary: Nvidia Corp. shares sank 7.4% on Tradegate following reports the AI chipmaker’s board is working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The move follows reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy. The Wall Street Journal said the board is preparing to oust Huang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
